datasets.title: Nepal: Landslides location
datasets.description: Geodata of landslides from earthquake on 25 April, 2015. East of Dharapani, Manang District, Nepal (50 Kilometers Northwest of Epicenter). [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/nepal-landslides-location]

lineage.description: Landslide locations were identified and mapped from satellite imagery acquired after the 25 April 2015 earthquake in Nepal, using direct observational interpretation by the US National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency. The dataset represents an empirical post-event inventory of triggered landslides in the Dharapani area, approximately 50 km northwest of the earthquake epicenter.

sources.name: US National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency
sources.description: Satellite-derived landslide location data mapped through direct observational analysis of post-earthquake imagery in the Manang District region
